integrity: The all-size sign result has a symbolic infinite-range proof and a reproducible exact-integer certificate for the complementary finite interval. Preexisting conditional crossing counts and Bell log-concavity are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform set partitions and linear successor-arc crossings are covered; generic crossing variants and weighted partition laws are not. Broad historical-priority certification is not claimed.
title: A 236-point covariance reversal for crossings and blocks in uniform set partitions
